title: ÐMP list Operation Schema
description: JSON Schema for the draft (pre-1.0) ÐMP list format (embedded psdt / psdt_hash, flat fee fields). Do not create new draft lists. ÐMP 1.0 fixed-price listings are compact orders: see list-v2.schema.json and compact-orders.md §4

currency.description: Optional; default DOGE. Must be DOGE if present.

psdt.description: Seller listing PSDT (base64). Preferred for portable Buy Now.

psdt_hash.description: SHA-256 of raw PSDT bytes (not the base64 string). Hash-only lists are not chain-alone fillable.

royalty_address.description: Draft (pre-1.0) fee field. ÐMP 1.0: fees.royalty_to on a compact order. Creator royalty pay-to address

royalty_bps.description: Draft (pre-1.0) fee field. ÐMP 1.0: fees.royalty_bps. Royalty basis points of sale price, 0..2500; above 2500 the listing is rejected (not clamped)

market_fee_bps.description: Draft (pre-1.0) fee field. ÐMP 1.0: fees.market_bps (0..2000, rejection). Total marketplace fee bps of sale price (listing + settlement venues combined), 0..2000; above 2000 the listing is rejected (not clamped)

listing_fee_address.description: Draft (pre-1.0) fee field. ÐMP 1.0: fees.listing_to. Listing venue fee address (collaborative multi-marketplace rake)

listing_fee_share_bps.description: Draft (pre-1.0) fee field. ÐMP 1.0: fees.listing_share_bps. Share of market_fee to listing venue (default 5000 = 50%)

listing_marketplace.description: Draft (pre-1.0) field with no ÐMP 1.0 equivalent. Optional listing venue label/domain — not a payee
